title: Contracted hiragana: R, G and J rows — find the form
description: Compare the base sign plus a small ゃ, ゅ or ょ with full-sized kana. The written spelling cue disambiguates similar sounds.

review.provenance: Original agent-authored contracted hiragana spelling cues and word examples; no legacy CSV or F00 text reused.
review.rightsBasis: Original English prompts, translations and explanations; kana spellings and short common-word meanings are linguistic facts. No copied work or audio.

exercises.prompt: Which written hiragana uses the ri base sign + small ya (rya)? Compare small and full-sized kana.

text.translation: Contracted hiragana rya, written with the ri base sign and small ya.
Full-sized kana spelling; not rya.
Different small kana spelling; not rya.

exercises.explanation: りゃ is rya: ri base sign + small ya. りや uses a full-sized kana, so it is a different spelling.
